Title: 503138-2026: France – Architectural services – DESIGN COMPETITION FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A MUNICIPAL TECHNICAL CENTER
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a municipal technical center with workshops and vehicle depots – a depot-type facility that is of interest for sbp. Location in France and no bridge or special large-scale structure reduces the priority.
titel: Competition for the design of a municipal technical center
kurzbeschreibung: Architectural competition for the new construction of a municipal depot with workshops and staff apartments.
umfang: New construction of a municipal technical center in a mountain location with 2788 m² SDO as well as 781 m² SDO staff apartments; additionally earthworks on the uphill side, embankments on the valley side, maneuvering and storage areas in the outdoor space, as well as an access ramp to the first floor.
leistungen: Architectural and general planning services within the framework of a design competition for the new construction; subsequent award of a service contract to one of the competition winners.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Building construction with a certain functional and topographical complexity due to the mountain location, earthworks, and operational use.
• Possible structural engineering relevance in the workshop, vehicle, and storage areas, but no explicit tender for structural design.
• Architectural competition may be strategically interesting, but the building type is more a municipal depot than a sophisticated cultural building or major project.
• Size with a total of around 3569 m² is medium and without apparent large spans or special structures.
• Only of limited relevance for sbp, as there are no clear indications of complex structural engineering tasks, lightweight construction, or innovative special structures.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated in the tender. A reliable estimate is not possible due to missing information on structure, standard, share of building services, scope of outdoor facilities, and regional cost level. Based on the program, this is a municipal depot with 2788 m² main usable area and 781 m² apartments in an alpine location; very roughly, the total costs of cost groups 300 and 400 could, depending on structural standard and share of building services, lie in the mid single-digit to low double-digit million range, but a realistic reliable figure cannot be derived from the documents.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee explicitly stated. As only a design competition is published and neither chargeable costs nor commissioned service profiles or fee bases are specified, no reliable fee estimate for sbp is possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria not listed in the contract notice; reference to the procurement documents.
zuschlagskriterien: Jury decision is binding; after the competition, each subsequent service contract will be awarded to one of the winners. No further award criteria and weightings are stated in the contract notice.
auftraggeber: Commune de Montvalezan, 1 place de la Mairie, 73700 Montvalezan, France, E-Mail: dst@montvalezan.fr, Telefon: +33 479068412, Website: https://montvalezan.e-marchespublics.com
notes: Competition notice in French. Project comprises a municipal depot with administrative rooms, vehicle shelters, workshops, storage areas, staff facilities, and seasonal staff apartments. Special features are the alpine location, architectural integration into the La Rosière resort, and requirements arising from winter service and special vehicles.
